name: Ploogins – AI Assistant
author: Sirvelia

sections.description:
Ploogins – AI Assistant helps you manage, install, and activate plugins with the power of AI. Save time, discover new plugins, and automate plugin tasks directly from your WordPress dashboard.

  • AI-powered plugin recommendations
  • One-click install and activation
  • Effortless plugin management

The Plugin calls an external public API at https://api.ploogins.com/public/search and https://api.suggerence.com/v1/. The plugin sends the user query while searching for plugins to get recommended plugins using AI.
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

Ploogins – AI Assistant helps you manage, install, and activate plugins using AI.

Is it free?

Yes, the core features are free. Some advanced features may require a subscription in the future.
